content.title: Who is Jenna Ortega dating? Controversy erupts around her boyfriend — here’s what happened
content.text: Actress Jenna Ortega has sparked significant online discussion after being repeatedly spotted with Danish musician Elias Rønnenfelt. Rumored relationship gains attentionAccording to spreading videos and photos, Jenna Ortega and Elias Rønnenfelt have been spotted together on many occasions. In one footage, he is seen placing his arm around her, fueling speculations that started in late 2025 when the two were reportedly found getting close at Copenhagen Airport. Ortega also appeared in his music clip for Mona Lisa last October.More recently, the pair were allegedly seen in Dublin on March 22, where a clip featured them being approached by a photographer. Ortega seemed to be visibly upset, while Rønnenfelt looked directly into the lens, an exchange that quickly went viral and heightened attention.Why fans are upsetMuch of the backlash focuses around Elias Rønnenfelt’s previous controversies. He is the frontman of Iceage, a Copenhagen-based punk rock band, and has experienced criticism due to provocative imagery and decisions linked to the group’s past years.In artwork made for Iceage when he was 18, Rønnenfelt used symbols connected to neo-Nazism and fascism. Addressing this in an interview with Pitchfork, he stated: “When a lot of these allegations came out, we were dumbfounded… Now I understand that we hold a responsibility on our shoulders to make it clear what we stand for.”He explained that the imagery was inspired by the 1980s film Roller Blade, claiming he did not grasp its political implications at the time. He said: “What some people took from it was not our intent… we are most definitely not right-wing and we don’t have any sympathies or leanings to that side.”Another controversy involved Iceage inviting a band with an offensive term to perform at a festival they organized. In the same interview, he acknowledged fault, citing: “There’s no way of excusing this… I f*cking deeply regret that we failed to speak up there… I’m embarrassed to have shared a stage with a band with that name.”Allegations and criticism resurfaceBeyond the imagery, earlier reports from Iceage’s past touring years have also resurfaced online, which includes allegations of aggressive behavior during performances. While these claims continue to be a part of broader online debate, they have resulted in the ongoing backlash.As a result, fans of Jenna Ortega have started re-examining her public persona, particularly given her status for taking strong principles.Fan reactions flood social mediaOnline reactions have been sharply divided, with several showing disappointment. Some viral remarks include: “I honestly love Jenna Ortega but don't know if I can support her anymore if she continues to hangout with this dude.”Another user cited: “How do you leave a film because you’re anti genocide then date a racist and pro-Nazi?”One user stated: “Imagine not watching Scream for this lying hypocrite.”And another mentioned: “Jenna Ortega girl... look at your life, look at your choices.”Ortega’s stance on relationshipsDespite the rumors, Jenna Ortega has consistently maintained her personal life private. In a 2023 interview with Elle, she described her hesitation toward relationships: “Maybe I am too obsessed with my work, but the idea of relationships stresses me out… I’m not ready to be that vulnerable or trusting with someone.”Who is Elias Rønnenfelt?Elias Rønnenfelt, also called Elias Bender Rønnenfelt, is a Danish musician in his early 30s and the lead singer of Iceage. He achieved recognition in the punk scene in his late teens, but his career has been repeatedly overshadowed by controversies connected to provocative imagery, artistic decisions, and reported onstage behavior.No confirmation, but growing attentionDespite widespread speculation, neither Ortega nor Rønnenfelt has officially confirmed a relationship. However, the repeated sightings and viral content have kept the topic trending online.FAQs:Q1. Who is Jenna Ortega dating? Jenna Ortega has been linked to Elias Rønnenfelt. However, neither has officially confirmed the relationship.Q2. Who is Elias Rønnenfelt? He is a Danish musician and the lead singer of Iceage. He is known for his work in the punk music scene.
